meta.title: JDVP Analyzer
meta.description: Analyze judgment delegation patterns in AI conversations

header.title: JDVP Analyzer
header.subtitle: Discover your judgment delegation patterns in AI conversations
header.description: Enter a ChatGPT share link or paste a conversation to see how judgment delegation shifts across 4 axes throughout the conversation.

input.pastePlaceholder:
Human: Hello
Assistant: Hi there!
Human: ...
input.linkHint: Enter the share link generated from ChatGPT

judgment_delegation.label: Judgment Delegation
judgment_delegation.description: Who is making the decisions? Higher means the user delegates judgment to AI; lower means the user decides independently.

cognitive_passivity.label: Cognitive Passivity
cognitive_passivity.description: How passively does the user accept information? Higher means accepting AI output without review; lower means critically evaluating.

information_dependency.label: Information Dependency
information_dependency.description: How much does the user depend on AI-provided information? Higher means using AI as the sole source; lower means leveraging own knowledge.
information_dependency.example_low: "As far as I know it's X, right?"

da_derived.label: Overall Delegation
da_derived.description: Weighted composite of 3 axes (JH, CP, ID) representing overall judgment delegation level. DA = 0.16×JH + 0.57×CP + 0.27×ID
da_derived.example_low: Conversations where AI is used as a tool

chart.title: Turn-by-Turn Analysis
chart.subtitle: Score changes across 4 axes per turn (0-10)

inflection.title: Key Inflection Points
inflection.description: Turns where significant delegation changes were detected

disclaimer.text: Conversation data is used for analysis only and is not stored on our servers. Anonymized usage statistics may be collected for service improvement.
